purpose: Verify complete legal-command omission/subset/ordering and lifecycle controls before a future acceptance-mapped package experiment. This is a prospective harness proof, not another selected historical-witness replay.
assignment: Five roles x two aspects x vows 0/5 x base/upgraded x baseline/control. All producer-action subsets crossed with consumer present/omitted. Fervor and Smolder additionally use the complete reversed command order. Facet needs ceiling(native rootheart facets / native Chisel chips) producer actions: three at V0 and four at V5. Fixed turn boundary after the third producer slot; skipped actions do not refund through artificial compensators.
controlled_state: One explicit hand/draw/deck arrangement after native rootheart combat creation. Native HP, facet maximum, Energy and core rules remain. Relics, omens, opening statuses and unrelated opening deck effects are excluded. This is a controlled legal-state fixture, not proof that seed 47080001 naturally acquires or deals that state, and not a complete Vow-5 guardrail test. All post-fixture changes must be genuine GlassvowGame.apply commands; no post-decision mediator rewrite, reinsertion, forced redraw or outcome-dependent action selection.

controls.facet: All proper subsets of the required Chisel sequence; pre-existing Vulnerable control; Ash no-Shatter control. Keep Stun and Shatter coupled.
controls.fervor: Omit Empower or Flurry; reverse their order; compare a one-hit Strike consumer to retain and quantify generic Strength contribution rather than deny it.
controls.cycle: First Momentum play, native end turn/shuffle/draw, then the same instance again. The control uses another instance as consumer. No manual bonus reset or hand insertion after fixture creation.
controls.smolder: Omit Venom Strike or Catalyst; reverse their order; include pre-existing poison. Report poison and immediate HP separately. Dusk player-Smolder exclusion stays active.
controls.hand: Night Sight, native end turn and draw, then Phantom Blades. Control has already-saturated draw capacity; no artificial post-fixture hand movement.

estimands: For each entire-command metric, Y(AB)-Y(A)-Y(B)+Y(empty), plus every proper producer subset and forward-minus-reverse. Retain health actually removed, nominal damage, net enemy HP, poison delta, player HP net and Energy spent as separate coordinates. Do not add different units.
predeclared_checks: Complete exact assignment, identical initial states within each fixture, actual legal commands, no hidden inter-command state mutation, true event/health accounting and complete retained outputs.
Baseline Fervor health interaction is positive and exceeds its positive one-hit control; baseline same-instance Growth is positive while different-instance control is zero.
Baseline Facet health interaction is positive for Dusk only; all proper producer subsets and pre-existing-Vulnerable control have zero incremental consumer interaction.
Smolder poison interaction is positive for Ash only; its immediate-health interaction is zero. Baseline/control hand interaction is positive/zero respectively.
Full Fervor order matters for health; full Smolder order matters for poison on Ash only.
failure_rule: Retain every assigned result and stop on watchdog, trace cap, invalid command, diagnostic or identity failure. A failed expected mechanism is not rescued by retuning the candidate, changing fixtures or relabelling the result. Mechanical verifier defects may be separately repaired with retained red/green proof under standing delivery authority; old native output is not overwritten.
review: Author adversarial self-review under the explicit owner exception, with negative fixtures; not independent review.
not_established: Canonical novelty against the complete closed-family quotient; the older Resonance pairing negative and Honing repeat/remap negative remain scoped and immutable.
Population or real-economy reachability, competent independent route policies, detector admission, endpoint retention, independent source-oracle qualification, protected qualification or P9.
A consumer law alone is not the entire package. Ash and Dusk Cycle share a mechanism; aspect-scoped claims are not six globally novel mechanisms.
